scope: Inventory only; does not complete or resume timed campaign reviews.

ideas.title: MF-13: dimension-six Lyapunov amplification
ideas.question: For every real 6-by-6 A, does the Frobenius operator norm of X -> AX+XA^T on symmetric matrices dominate its restriction to skew matrices, or is there an exact counterexample?
ideas.obstacle: Controlling a continuum of full-rank compatible pairs, including degenerate strata; rank-four exclusion and three-moment sufficiency cannot be assumed solely from local numerics.
ideas.cheap_test: Independently derive the fixed-pair linear operator and check rank/cokernel at an exact generic and a repeated-spectrum pair; test whether three moments suffice in both, with no generic-to-global leap.

ideas.title: Slow command filters with useful forced tracking
ideas.question: Can a causal slow command filter meet the fixed 0.2 mm tracking task while reducing actual jerk or command variation relative to direct control?
ideas.obstacle: Unforced stability does not imply useful forced tracking; moving endpoints or granting preview changes the task.
ideas.cheap_test: Derive the augmented transfer function and compare its low-frequency moments against direct feedback before any gain search.

ideas.title: Uncertainty-preserving action under ambiguous attribution
ideas.question: Can a safety decision remain sound when source attribution stays nonidentifiable and sensor observations contain duplicated shared information?
ideas.obstacle: Point estimates or falsely independent duplicated constraints can manufacture confidence; hull intersection can hide disconnected infeasibility.
ideas.cheap_test: Compare an exact union-of-polyhedra feasible set with its interval hull on a held-out observation that intersects the hull but no actual branch.

ideas.title: Epipolar validity versus pose identifiability
ideas.question: When do calibrated two-view correspondences determine a rigid pose, and how do planar scenes or zero baseline affect identifiability without invalidating the epipolar identity?
ideas.obstacle: Need separate SO(3), nonzero translation, nonzero rays and observability conditions; algebraic satisfaction is not unique reconstruction.
ideas.cheap_test: Build planar correspondences satisfying two distinct epipolar matrices, and a pure-rotation zero-E case; verify identity separately from rank.

ideas.title: Task intent versus measurement ambiguity
ideas.question: What authoritative task information is necessary to distinguish a true small move from noisy observations of a hold without silently suppressing intended motion?
ideas.obstacle: Intent remains a trusted input; identical numeric histories cannot reveal incompatible hidden tasks.
ideas.cheap_test: Replay identical 1 mm packets under hold and move truths with disjoint 0.2 mm goal bands; demonstrate no packet-only universal success.

ideas.title: Erdos 885: extend the exact 6-by-4 square-sum grid
ideas.question: Can the saved rational 6-by-4 square-sum grid acquire a fifth distinct column, yielding five distinct integers whose factor-difference sets share five differences?
ideas.obstacle: One common rational extension must satisfy six simultaneous square conditions; bounded denominator failures do not prove nonexistence.
ideas.cheap_test: Derive one exact cycle/elimination invariant for the stored grid; verify it on all existing columns and use it to reject a bounded rational candidate set.

ideas.title: Choose feedforward for the actual performance objective
ideas.question: Which jerk-feedforward coefficient minimizes finite-horizon position error rather than the invariant-cube residual or initial jerk error?
ideas.obstacle: A certificate-optimal coefficient can be poor on the real task; varying-rate worst cases are not established.
ideas.cheap_test: For a fixed polynomial reference compute exact low-order error series for the three coefficients and locate the horizon where their ranking reverses.

ideas.title: From finite constructed handoff to ongoing execution
ideas.question: Can the finite recovery/detector/pending/hold construction be extended consistently to one infinite non-Zeno execution with the same safety ceiling?
ideas.obstacle: Compatible finite horizons and prefix agreement must be proved, rather than extending a finite formula outside its theorem domain.
ideas.cheap_test: Compare the N and N+1 recurrences symbolically on their common horizon and identify the exact index-stability lemma needed.

ideas.title: Outlier admission in information filtering
ideas.question: Can a geometric outlier-rejection rule preserve a stated estimation-error bound when combined with an additive information update?
ideas.obstacle: Posterior covariance algebra does not bound actual error under biased or misclassified measurements; observation and noise assumptions are missing.
ideas.cheap_test: Scalar counterexample: very precise biased measurement decreases covariance while increasing actual error; then test bounded-error interval admission.

ideas.title: Complete moving-goal admission contract
ideas.question: Can retained-history motion admission enforce velocity, acceleration, jerk and task deadline simultaneously during reversal, while competing with native online planning?
ideas.obstacle: Jerk-only correctness is insufficient; preserving old motion can cause large goal error. No universal planner replacement established.
ideas.cheap_test: Reproduce ordinary-return exact acceleration 21/32 against 1/2 limit and far-reversal rejection; add full V/A/J feasibility check without changing history.

ideas.title: Erdos 273: conditional capacity beyond seven-smooth moduli
ideas.question: Can the conditional residue-capacity method rigorously exclude every finite distinct-modulus prime-minus-one covering whose moduli are eleven-smooth, and identify the obstruction at thirteen-smooth?
ideas.obstacle: Need universal tail control, distinctness, residue conditioning, and an assembled quantifier-faithful proof; a finite sieve or search result alone is insufficient.
ideas.cheap_test: Replay the eleven-smooth certificate independently with rational arithmetic; compare one adaptive residue partition against the saved fixed prefix without weakening the infinite tail.

ideas.title: Co-design digital hold gains and information age
ideas.question: Can the fixed digital-hold controller admit a materially larger total information age without widening the declared clearance tube?
ideas.obstacle: The sufficient budget has little slack and gain changes alter both sensor amplification and contraction.
ideas.cheap_test: Express the two-pass age inequality symbolically in gains and identify whether reducing slope increases admitted age after retaining the same cube.

ideas.title: Detector correctness under variable dispatch latency
ideas.question: Can first qualifying sampled readings remain causally linked to the switched plant when dispatch latency varies and messages can tie or reorder?
ideas.obstacle: Common latency gives strict arrival order; arbitrary variable delays do not.
ideas.cheap_test: Construct two bounded-latency readings that arrive out of order and test a latest-timestamp-only acceptance rule against the age bound.

ideas.title: Robust point-cloud registration
ideas.question: Which translation/rotation/scale ambiguities and outlier patterns prevent a certifiable rigid point-cloud registration on small fixtures?
ideas.obstacle: Must distinguish correspondences from correspondence search, bounded noise from adversarial data, and conditional certificate from guaranteed success.
ideas.cheap_test: Create two congruent subcloud explanations and test whether a proposed certificate rejects ambiguity rather than selecting a convenient alignment.

ideas.title: Franka model and total-torque transfer gap
ideas.question: What explicit coupled tracking and total-actuation contract could justify transferring scalar checked references to the recorded FR3 simulation or a specified physical Franka arm?
ideas.obstacle: Exact hardware variant unknown; ideal bias assistance is not firmware, total torque is unbounded by retained actuator clamp, and sampled convergence is not proof.
ideas.cheap_test: From a recorded assisted state, sum position-actuator force and ideal bias force; test total bound and compare flange error against claimed scalar tube.

ideas.title: GU dissertation: reproduce the symbol determinant fixtures
ideas.question: Can an exact reconstruction of the dissertation Appendix A symbol map reproduce all six supplied ten-coefficient fixtures, including the singular control, for its 448-by-448 matrix?
ideas.obstacle: Representation projections, basis order and normalization must match the scanned source before determinant comparisons mean anything.
ideas.cheap_test: Choose one fixture and reconstruct a small projection block with exact arithmetic; check dimensions, idempotence and source basis order, then define modular rank fingerprints with an exact-verification path.

ideas.title: Finite-horizon tracking bounds beyond invariant cubes
ideas.question: Can a finite-horizon tube certify the short-move task that a global invariant cube makes excessively conservative?
ideas.obstacle: An all-time cube discards transient cancellations; sampled numerical passes are not continuous enclosures.
ideas.cheap_test: Propagate a small interval state through one saved polynomial phase and compare its position envelope to the fixed R tube without changing the task.

ideas.title: Travel containment versus maintained rest
ideas.question: What additional controller and contract are needed to guarantee two-sided travel and explicit residual-motion tolerances after the finite first-zero maneuver?
ideas.obstacle: First velocity zero is neither standstill nor a maintained stop; negative braking can reverse direction.
ideas.cheap_test: Propagate the first-zero state under unchanged braking and construct the earliest backward-travel violation, then derive the necessary hold-switch reserve.

ideas.title: Pose-graph synchronization certificates
ideas.question: Can a small inconsistent relative-pose graph be accompanied by an independently checked certificate of global optimum after gauge fixing?
ideas.obstacle: Gauge freedom, disconnected graphs and relaxation tightness must be made explicit.
ideas.cheap_test: Use a three-node rotation cycle with one inconsistent edge and compare exact cycle residuals, feasible objective and a lower bound.

ideas.title: Minimal intervention on redundant arms
ideas.question: Can a robot avoid correcting task-irrelevant joint deviations while maintaining explicit task, obstacle and actuator constraints?
ideas.obstacle: Null-space freedom can violate constraints and disappears near singularities; biological analogy is motivation only.
ideas.cheap_test: Two-joint scalar task x=q1+q2: compare full joint correction with null-space motion while enforcing joint bounds; add a singular Jacobian case.

ideas.title: GU curvature: bridge the bounded contraction to draft 9.3
ideas.question: Under explicit algebraic Riemann symmetries in signature (7,7), does the constructed commutator/Jordan Einstein contraction equal a convention-fixed version of draft equation 9.3 after the Hodge identification?
ideas.obstacle: Pointwise degree-one output must be matched to source degree-thirteen output with the exact orientation, products and normalization.
ideas.cheap_test: Work one mixed-sign curvature basis element through both component and exterior formulas, including Hodge signs, then use a Bianchi-violating control to expose any illicit domain extension.

ideas.title: Safe excitation for coupled-source identifiability
ideas.question: Can a bounded intervention distinguish wheel imbalance from synchronous drivetrain forcing enough to change a safe control decision?
ideas.obstacle: Known trial sensitivity alone does not identify baseline imbalance; dynamic plant/interface and phase errors are absent.
ideas.cheap_test: Construct the rank-deficient two-source observation map, then add one phase/order-separating row and quantify feasible-set width under bounded error.

ideas.title: Complete model-bound certificate acceptance
ideas.question: Can a certificate checker reject incomplete coverage, changed model semantics and stale artifacts without trusting the producer?
ideas.obstacle: Mathematical validity of supplied branches does not prove all required branches were supplied.
ideas.cheap_test: Delete one required branch from a copied in-memory certificate and verify that coverage fails before any accepted summary can be emitted.

ideas.title: Global bounded-reprojection feasibility
ideas.question: Under positive depth and fixed versus unknown rotations, which multiview maximum-reprojection-error subproblems admit convex feasibility certificates?
ideas.obstacle: Whole pose estimation is not made convex by naming an SOCP; rotation and denominator domains matter.
ideas.cheap_test: For two fixed cameras, test a triangulation error threshold using explicit cone inequalities; change rotation to show where fixed-camera convexity breaks.

ideas.title: Moving-base gaze stabilization
ideas.question: Can a small execution layer maintain a world-frame optical output while a supporting robot moves and a slower visual task changes?
ideas.obstacle: Need multirate delay, authority, signal and domain models; IMAX mechanism unverified and no universal tremor cause follows.
ideas.cheap_test: Scalar base angle plus fast actuator and delayed outer visual loop; isolate coordinated feedforward versus inconsistent frame/loop state.

ideas.title: Sparse-half graph bound: missing middle-density certificate
ideas.question: Can a new exact graph constraint close the triangle-free cut bound 2/47 in the remaining density interval 8/47 < 2m/n^2 < 49/125 without an unverified BCL premise?
ideas.obstacle: Need concrete graph/flag semantics, exact positivity evidence and uniform finite-error control, not a numerical bound on finitely many graphs.
ideas.cheap_test: Enumerate the existing tiny triangle-free graph class and test one newly proposed motif inequality; exhibit a counterexample immediately if it fails, otherwise retain only as a conjectured constraint.

ideas.title: Causal high-order reference feasibility
ideas.question: Can a compact admission rule reject impossible endpoint/deadline requests with bounded jerk, snap and latency before controller synthesis?
ideas.obstacle: Zero acceleration is not zero velocity; preserving a full endpoint is stricter than delaying one event.
ideas.cheap_test: Derive simultaneous lower bounds on position and velocity from the extremal jerk profile and compare to the saved rejected endpoint.

ideas.title: Saturation certificate scope and hidden inactive regimes
ideas.question: Can a robust invariant include genuinely active clipping throughout a region without relying on a budget that secretly forces clipping inactive?
ideas.obstacle: Reusing the local budget as evidence for a broad saturated basin changes the proved statement.
ideas.cheap_test: Find the exact intersection of each candidate invariant with the active-clamp halfspaces and reject any advertised clipping result with empty intersection.

ideas.title: Planar camera calibration identifiability
ideas.question: Which planar checkerboard views provide enough independent constraints to recover camera intrinsics, and how can a calibration carry a rank/consistency check?
ideas.obstacle: Need calibration model, view diversity and noise assumptions; a homography proof does not prove intrinsic recovery.
ideas.cheap_test: Compare repeated fronto-parallel views to tilted synthetic views using the intrinsic-constraint matrix rank.

ideas.title: Reference continuity across native replanning
ideas.question: Can an execution adapter preserve the actual native trajectory jet across repeated replacements and retain all real jump contributions in its metrics?
ideas.obstacle: Finite sampled agreement is not continuous-runtime or firmware correctness; clock rounding and zero-duration metadata matter.
ideas.cheap_test: Use one superseded short native phase and compare both sides of q/v/a at execution joins under exact binary-origin conversion.

ideas.title: GU invariant forms: equivalence under the permitted gauge group
ideas.question: For H_t=K(I+tW), which parameters remain equivalent when coordinate changes are restricted to the source-specific admissible transformations and all accompanying fields are transformed consistently?
ideas.obstacle: The admissible group and field transformation laws must be identified before assigning physical significance to a parameter.
ideas.cheap_test: Test the explicit S=aI+bW against each source-stated preservation constraint; separate a proven obstruction from an unspecified convention, and check t=0 and nonzero rational controls.

ideas.title: Active-facet geometry for invariant entry
ideas.question: Can active-facet geometry yield a less conservative full-state entry test than independent box bounds for the tilted hold cube?
ideas.obstacle: Shared physical coordinates couple the facets; independent coordinate extrema may be unattainable together.
ideas.cheap_test: Enumerate signed active facets of the 3D tilted cube and find which combinations are feasible under the saved sensor and pending-command bounds.

ideas.title: Machine arithmetic to real-valued control theorem
ideas.question: What error contract lets a finite-word implementation inherit the real-valued clipped controller guarantee, including overflow and rounding?
ideas.obstacle: Rounding, clamp order and overflow can violate the assumed error channel.
ideas.cheap_test: Evaluate one control expression over boundary-state intervals using a declared fixed-point format and derive an exact worst rounding/overflow bound.

ideas.title: Faithful projective plane transfer
ideas.question: Under explicit nonzero-ray, depth and invertibility conditions, which projective incidences and plane-induced image constraints survive a camera-frame change?
ideas.obstacle: Vector identities do not alone establish a projective quotient camera pipeline or physical calibration; proposal overstates failure of epipolar geometry on planes.
ideas.cheap_test: Construct rational plane points and invertible H; check incidence and depth scaling, then test singular H and zero rays.

ideas.title: Atomic future commit under clock uncertainty
ideas.question: Can a candidate future trajectory be committed only while its history, task, frame and timing snapshot remains valid under bounded clock error?
ideas.obstacle: Ordering bounds do not establish atomic state binding or physical progress; real executor absent.
ideas.cheap_test: Enumerate interleavings of proposal, goal revision and commit; reject stale version even when time inequality passes.

ideas.title: Erdos 939: primitive infinite family at r=5
ideas.question: Can one construct infinitely many distinct three-element sets of positive five-powerful integers with collective gcd one and five-powerful sum?
ideas.obstacle: Scaling known examples destroys collective gcd one; the r>=6 binomial construction has too many terms for direct reuse.
ideas.cheap_test: Expand one proposed three-term identity exactly and audit positivity, distinctness, valuations and collective gcd symbolically; reject mere rescalings of the known example.

ideas.title: Sharp stopping clearance from transient structure
ideas.question: Can the derived-loss rate-floor model obtain a reusable tight clearance formula rather than a loose polynomial relaxation or one numerical instance?
ideas.obstacle: General parameter dependence and certified near-tightness remain separate from one fixed certificate.
ideas.cheap_test: On the saved instance derive a rational root bracket from monotone velocity and bound the position slack inside it.

ideas.title: Within-hold disturbance semantics
ideas.question: Can the fixed held-error safety theorem tolerate bounded within-hold forcing without silently reusing constant-input formulas?
ideas.obstacle: Constant-flow equalities and all-time energy certificates do not automatically transfer to arbitrary forcing.
ideas.cheap_test: Compute the exact impulse-response sign pattern on one hold and compare constant worst-case forcing with a sign-aligned bounded forcing.

ideas.title: Homography pose ambiguity and cheirality
ideas.question: Given a calibrated plane-induced homography, which rigid pose and plane candidates satisfy reconstruction and positive-depth constraints, including degeneracies?
ideas.obstacle: Survey fixed eight-to-two multiplicity and novelty claims are not established; pure rotation, scale conventions and visible points can change ambiguity.
ideas.cheap_test: For identity, pure translation and generic rotation homographies, test candidate reconstruction and signed depths; report sets rather than fixed count.

ideas.title: Conditional scheduler progress
ideas.question: Under what feasible-task margin, candidate coverage, computation bounds and request-rate assumptions must the executor eventually accept a request?
ideas.obstacle: An always-reject checker is sound but useless; a finite candidate search is not completeness.
ideas.cheap_test: Small discrete scheduler model with a feasible execution slot; compare bounded exhaustive slot coverage to starvation under repeated supersession.

ideas.title: Parker square: nine distinct squares in a magic grid
ideas.question: Can a 3-by-3 array of nine distinct positive integer squares have equal row, column and both diagonal sums?
ideas.obstacle: Easy exact verification masks hard discovery; arbitrary bounded search gives no global negative result.
ideas.cheap_test: Derive the standard affine magic-square parametrization independently, check it exactly, and map square constraints to a low-dimensional modular sieve with a nondegeneracy test.

ideas.title: Whole-region recovery controller comparison
ideas.question: When braking and direct feedback share the same initial box and plant assumptions, which has the larger certified recovery region per checking cost?
ideas.obstacle: Single-cell wins and endpoint-only comparisons cannot establish whole-region superiority.
ideas.cheap_test: Identify a pair of neighboring cells sharing valid coefficient bounds and test whether one terminal certificate can cover their union.

ideas.title: Common-cause failures at the proof/reliability interface
ideas.question: How can deterministic execution guarantees be composed with an explicit fault process without pretending proof success establishes a safety performance level?
ideas.obstacle: A per-stop exceedance probability cannot be converted to an hourly failure rate without an operational model; shared causes defeat independent multiplication.
ideas.cheap_test: Build a minimal symbolic two-channel fault model with one shared cause and show the gap between independent and common-cause failure calculations.

ideas.title: Certifiable robust Wahba rotation
ideas.question: Can an outlier-corrupted rotation estimate carry a checkable lower-bound certificate matching its feasible objective under a stated noise/outlier model?
ideas.obstacle: Numerical PSD and claimed universal zero duality gap are insufficient; exactness depends on instance and assumptions.
ideas.cheap_test: Construct a tiny rotation dataset with one controlled outlier and independently check primal residual and rational dual slack.

ideas.title: Bounded retained-history storage
ideas.question: Can the retained-event execution contract obtain a finite memory and checking-time bound while preserving all active and future commitments?
ideas.obstacle: Requires arrival-rate or admission assumptions; deleting future events changes the task.
ideas.cheap_test: Send arbitrarily dense accepted future events in one support window; derive counterexample to pruning-only bounded memory, then bound count under minimum spacing.

ideas.title: Shallit substitution sequence: singular shifted Hankel windows
ideas.question: Does the fixed point of 1->12, 2->23, 3->14, 4->32 have a shifted Hankel matrix with zero determinant, or can nonvanishing be proved for all sizes and offsets?
ideas.obstacle: A finite counterexample is decisive, but finite nonzero tests cannot prove the all-size property; exact formulation and current status require source refresh.
ideas.cheap_test: Confirm indexing/alphabet values from the primary slide, generate a bounded exact prefix, compare fraction-free determinants with modular ranks, and test one substitution-induced recurrence on held-out windows.

ideas.title: Sample-interval certificate conservatism
ideas.question: How much allowable sampling range is lost to Bernstein/LDL certificates compared with true held-map stability on the same normalized plant?
ideas.obstacle: Failure of the chosen common quadratic or Bernstein coefficient test is not instability.
ideas.cheap_test: For the 2-state benchmark compute the exact Schur stability polynomial and compare its boundary to the stored certificate interval.

ideas.title: Population uncertainty to a conditional envelope
ideas.question: What evidence contract converts multi-unit, repeated-condition stopping data into a calibrated uncertainty set while retaining separate statistical and deterministic claims?
ideas.obstacle: Repeated measurements can share temperature and calibration errors; an empirical percentile is not an all-trajectories bound.
ideas.cheap_test: Create a small exact synthetic shared-bias example showing row-wise replication reduces naive uncertainty while leaving between-unit uncertainty unchanged.

ideas.title: Minimal relative pose and degeneracy
ideas.question: Can a five-correspondence calibrated relative-pose solve distinguish isolated real solutions from degenerate solution families with a checkable certificate?
ideas.obstacle: Need actual elimination equations and saturation conditions; quotient-ring dimension and generic root count are not guarantees for every instance.
ideas.cheap_test: Compare a generic five-ray fixture with planar/pure-rotation fixtures; test rank and substitution residuals of all claimed candidates.

ideas.title: World-frame derivative transport
ideas.question: Can world-frame output constraints be preserved when body motion, frame/calibration updates and coupled robot kinematics transform an actuator reference?
ideas.obstacle: Componentwise limits do not imply Cartesian bounds; rotating-frame terms and singularities can amplify error.
ideas.cheap_test: Two-dimensional rotating base with constant body-frame vector: calculate nonzero world velocity/acceleration and expose an omitted transport term.

ideas.title: Erdos 939: first primitive four-powerful sum
ideas.question: Is there a pair of distinct positive coprime four-powerful integers a,b whose sum is also four-powerful?
ideas.obstacle: Naive search ranges are enormous; exponent constraints and coprimality must survive every transformation.
ideas.cheap_test: Enumerate a small valuation-support pattern family and prove exact modular obstructions for each rejected pattern; any surviving witness gets independent factorization and gcd checks.

ideas.title: Separate actuator response rate from authority loss
ideas.question: What minimal varying-rate and effective-target model captures meaningful stopping variability without disguising reduced braking strength as slower response?
ideas.obstacle: No calibrated mechanism or data validates a particular rate/target uncertainty set.
ideas.cheap_test: Construct equal-time-constant models with different steady acceleration and test the saved clearance contract on both; then identify the missing authority premise.

ideas.title: Own-state quantization and execution uniqueness
ideas.question: Can existence and uniqueness be established for the sampled controller with deterministic state-dependent quantization rather than prescribed error sequences?
ideas.obstacle: An arbitrary bounded error sequence and a deterministic quantizer are different closed-loop interfaces.
ideas.cheap_test: Write the deterministic sample recurrence and check that a tie-breaking convention yields a unique next state even at quantizer boundaries.

ideas.title: Complete minimal absolute-pose candidates
ideas.question: Can a P3P minimal solver produce all physically admissible camera poses for a three-point instance with a checkable real-root certificate?
ideas.obstacle: Numerical action-matrix eigenvalues are not automatically complete exact roots; singular and repeated-root cases need treatment.
ideas.cheap_test: Choose rational geometry, derive its range equations, isolate roots and reconstruct each pose; test collinear input rejection.

ideas.title: Energy benefit versus smoothness proxies
ideas.question: Does a smoother successful robot trajectory reduce a defined mechanical or electrical energy quantity once task, timing, payload and losses are matched?
ideas.obstacle: No electrical/mechanical energy measurement exists in scalar acceleration-command model; prior methods start revisions at different distances.
ideas.cheap_test: Compare equal-duration rest-to-rest polynomials in an inertia-plus-viscous-loss model, reporting net work, positive work, loss and jerk separately.

ideas.title: Online matrix-vector conjecture: structured-input crossover
ideas.question: Can a concrete restriction arising from control or vision admit faster online Boolean matrix-vector multiplication while preserving the online arrival constraint, and exactly where does that restriction cease to address the general OMv conjecture?
ideas.obstacle: The general conjecture cannot be settled by timing finite inputs; useful structured progress needs explicit input class, online semantics and operation bounds.
ideas.cheap_test: Write a tiny adversarial online sequence for one proposed structured class and audit whether preprocessing/update costs secretly restore cubic work or use unavailable future vectors.

ideas.title: Reusable certificates on a genuinely different plant
ideas.question: Can an independent second plant use the unchanged interval-certificate interface with less manual proof work than a fresh bespoke derivation?
ideas.obstacle: Another rescaling of the same model is not evidence of reusable abstraction.
ideas.cheap_test: Take the existing coupled-planar benchmark, list its model-specific proof obligations, and test whether its generated certificate can be consumed unchanged by the common interface.

ideas.title: Diagnose mismatch while a safe fallback remains reachable
ideas.question: Can a runtime model monitor detect a specific actuator fault early enough that a certified fallback is still available?
ideas.obstacle: Detecting a model violation after the recoverable set has been left offers no safety guarantee.
ideas.cheap_test: For a declared bounded authority-loss fault, compare earliest distinguishable residual time with the latest safe brake-switch time.

ideas.title: Point-line multiview reconstruction
ideas.question: For a selected small complete-visibility point-line configuration, can all consistent multiview reconstructions be enumerated and validated?
ideas.obstacle: A named method is not a specified finite problem; choose one published configuration and verify path-completeness assumptions first.
ideas.cheap_test: Select a triangle of point/line incidences in two or three views, count degrees of freedom, and exhibit a gauge or degeneracy witness before solver work.

ideas.title: Fair native industrial motion comparison
ideas.question: What common task and replacement semantics permit a fair comparison between an external execution contract and native buffered industrial interpolation?
ideas.obstacle: Stop-between-point, buffered target and incremental interfaces have distinct semantics; proprietary derivative objectives unknown.
ideas.cheap_test: Specify paired abstract buffered versus stop-at-each-point traces; show cycle-time advantage disappears or changes when interpolation ownership is matched.
